title: Isaiah Bible Quiz - Chapter 18
description: Ten questions on Isaiah 18: the land of the rustling of wings, swift messengers in papyrus vessels, and a present brought to Mount Zion.

questions.text: Where does verse 1 place the land of the rustling of wings?
questions.explanation: Verse 1 says, "Ah, the land of the rustling of wings, which is beyond the rivers of Ethiopia."

answers.text: In the wilderness of the south

questions.text: In what kind of vessels does this land send ambassadors by the sea?
questions.explanation: Verse 2 says it sends ambassadors by the sea, even in vessels of papyrus on the waters.

questions.text: How is the nation to which the messengers are sent described?
questions.explanation: Verse 2 describes them as a nation tall and smooth, a people awesome from their beginning onward.

questions.text: What should the inhabitants of the world do when a banner is lifted up on the mountains?
questions.explanation: Verse 3 calls all inhabitants of the world to look when a banner is lifted up, and to listen when the trumpet is blown.

questions.text: What does Yahweh say he will do in his dwelling place?
questions.explanation: Verse 4 says, "I will be still, and I will see in my dwelling place, like clear heat in sunshine."

questions.text: With what are the sprigs cut off before the harvest?
questions.explanation: Verse 5 says that before the harvest he will cut off the sprigs with pruning hooks and take away the spreading branches.

questions.text: For whom are the cut branches left together?
questions.explanation: Verse 6 says they will be left together for the ravenous birds of the mountains and for the animals of the earth.

answers.text: The poor and the stranger in the land
The ravenous birds and the animals of the earth
The fire that burns in the oven

questions.text: In which season will all the animals of the earth eat them?
questions.explanation: Verse 6 says the ravenous birds will eat them in the summer, and all the animals of the earth will eat them in the winter.

questions.text: What will be brought to Yahweh of Armies in that time?
questions.explanation: Verse 7 says a present will be brought to Yahweh of Armies from a people tall and smooth.

answers.text: A tribute of horses and chariots
A present from a people tall and smooth
The spoils of the land of Egypt
A cedar cut from Lebanon for the temple

questions.text: To what place will the present be brought?
questions.explanation: Verse 7 says it will be brought to the place of the name of Yahweh of Armies, Mount Zion.
